resourceHandoff.policy: Source-only merge is not resource delivery. Transfer complete payloads additively with hash checks.

mothers.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repaint four original Red Alert 2 Urban facilities in a 2 by 2 sprite sheet. Top left CAPARK04 diagonal green bench, top right CAPARK05 opposite diagonal green bench, bottom left CAPARK06 curved green bench, bottom right CAMISC06 three red-and-white banners on stone posts. Preserve exact original geometry, view, green painted wood, black metal feet, red-white fabric, stone posts, original illumination and relative feature placement. Resolve actual fine wood, metal, fabric and stone detail for independent 2X and 4X sprites, with coherent restrained surfaces. No new objects, grounds, cast shadows, fire, text, frames, checkerboards or patterns. Keep every subject filling the exact original reference extent in its separate equal cell, with transparent gutters and margins. Output true transparent 1254 by 1254 square canvas. No shrinking, ordinary enlargement or sharpening as new detail.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: reusable Red Alert 2 Urban high-resolution game sprites. Edit target: this exact original guide with 2 columns and 1 rows, row-major subjects curus02a.shp-000, curus02a.shp-001. Repaint the complete original architecture or street facility in each cell with genuinely resolved masonry, roofing, glazing, painted metal, fabric and state-specific damage for independently detailed 2X and 4X sprites. Preserve the original silhouette, native isometric perspective, architecture, original colors and upper-left light. Do not redesign, exaggerate wear, add patterns, snow, new ground, cast shadows, fire, smoke, text, frames or checkerboards. Preserve all surviving rubble fragments, sandbags, flags and small detached source elements where shown. Rubble must remain its original low flat debris arrangement in its original Iso colors. Use restrained coherent material detail, not sharpening or ordinary enlargement as new detail. Keep all subjects large at the exact reference positions and scale, with completely transparent gutters at every equal cell divider and outer margins. True transparent 1880 by 1254 canvas, exact reference aspect ratio. Do not shrink the subjects. Each equal cell is independent; do not connect objects across cells.
